## Current consolidated truth
The Larkspur ferry inspection is on May 21 (@ID@). Tobiah Quell moved it there from May 14, and Wenna Ostrow confirmed the new date with the harbour office, so the office and the crew work from the same day. Wenna Ostrow also signs off any spending of the inspection crew, which makes her the one person to ask about the inspection, its date and what the crew may buy for it.

The thread is short and settled. The date is the only value that changed, and the earlier date is history: anyone planning around the inspection should use the live date above. The ferry will be out of service for the day of the inspection, and passengers need a notice about it a week ahead, which the thread names as an open item rather than a decision. The thread does not say who writes that notice, so it stays open below, together with the question of whether the harbour office needs anything else from the crew before the day.

What the crew does on the day is not part of this thread: the inspection checklist, the order of the decks and the paperwork for the harbour office are handled elsewhere and are not consolidated here. This rollup only carries the date, who confirmed it and who signs off spending, so that a later rollup of the inspection itself can build on a settled date.
